newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - July 1.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - July 1.

text.p: -- A U.S. district judge granted government trustbusters a preliminary injunction halting the proposed $4 billion merger of office superstore chains Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc. Staples closed at 23-1/4 Monday while Office Depot closed at 19-7/16.

-- Viacom Inc asked a judge to hold a public auction of USA Networks, the cable partnership jointly owned by Viacom and Seagram Co Ltd. According to court documents, Viacom chose the auction remedy after its offer to buy out Seagram for $1.94 billion was rejected. Viacom closed at 29-7/16 while Seagram closed at 55.50 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

-- FORE Systems said it expects first quarter net income of $4.7-$6.0 million, or $0.05-$0.06 per share, on revenues of $95-$97 million. The First Call consensus earnings estimate is $0.08 per share. FORE closed at 13-5/8.
-- Federal Express reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.14 per share compared to $1.01 a year earlier. The stock closed at 57-3/4.
